bandas.nombre: Cobertura vegetal; proporción de superficie vegetada

tags.denominator: Valid MOD44B retrieval surfaces; CMG means are not necessarily full-cell-area fractions
tags.interpretation: 0=no vegetation; 1=fully vegetated within valid retrieved surface

tags.attribution: DiMiceli et al., MOD44B.061, doi:10.5067/MODIS/MOD44B.061; globally gridded by ICDC, CEN, University of Hamburg, doi:10.25592/uhhfdm.11195; Thanks to ICDC for data support
tags.crs_note: Source CF geographic degree coordinates; WGS84 chosen for project angular grid; no resampling of native CMG
tags.missing_note: Source fill127 and unknown ocean/ice remain NaN; unknown is not zero vegetation
tags.precision_note: Source integer percentages; step0.01, not measurement accuracy; actual maximum need not reach1
tags.quality_note: Positive useful observation count required; all ICDC supplied quality levels retained, no additional cloud-quality threshold
tags.source_scope_note: ICDC fractions are means over valid 250m MOD44B retrievals, not necessarily the entire CMG cell surface; summary band2 counts known CMG cells, not within-cell retrieval coverage or QA
tags.source_spatial_resolution: 0.5 degree ICDC CMG; original MOD44B retrievals at 250 m
